# Replace book figure generation with epix (ported from geometricalgebra)

**Status:** proposed — needs go-ahead
**Priority:** 6
**Difficulty:** 7
**Created:** 2026-10-11 (William Emerison Six <billsix@gmail.com>)
**Scope settled:** 2026-10-11 (Q1–Q4 answered — see "Decisions settled")

## BLUF

Port geometricalgebra's **ePiX** figure pipeline into mvp so the book's
*mathematical coordinate/vector/transformation plots* are generated by ePiX (the
C++ figure library + its Python front-end), built locally in-container behind a
`USE_EPIX` build flag — exactly the pattern gacalc uses. **ePiX replaces only the
math plots** — the live **gnuplot (14)** and **matplotlib (21 frames)** figures —
and **coexists** with graphviz, `texExpToPng`/`inlinetex`, and the notebooks,
which stay (ePiX is the wrong tool for graph auto-layout, math-label
rasterization, and executed notebooks; gacalc made the same coexist call).
**Investigation shrank the target from "~170 SVGs" to ~35 live figures:** of
`generate_plots.py`'s ~23 output families only **5 are embedded in the book** (21
specific frames); the other ~18 (`*-backwards`, `rotate0/1/2`, `covariance`,
`circle`, `ortho2d`, `inverse-ortho2d`) are **orphaned** — referenced by no
chapter, notebook, or assignment (verified 2026-10-11). The ePiX figures will
**drive mvp's own taught transform code** (`mathutils` → gacalc
`InvertibleFunction`s), retiring `plotutils/mpltransformations.py`. "Done" = those
~35 figures are ePiX-generated in-container under `USE_EPIX`, the orphan families
and their generator are retired (confirmed dead by Bill 2026-10-11), and the clean
containerized book build (html + latexpdf + epub) is green with no reference
regressions. All decisions are settled; ready to execute on go-ahead.

## Context (read first, cold-start orientation)

**What to read, in order:**

1. `tasks/reference/book-figures-and-images.md` — mvp's own authoritative map of
   the five figure toolchains and the `inlinetex` extension. Everything in §"mvp's
   current figure toolchains" below is distilled from it.
2. `tasks/reference/book-and-docs-pipeline.md` — the Sphinx build sequence and the
   `literalinclude` doc-region mechanism.
3. The gacalc precedent (sibling repo `/foo/opt/geometricalgebra`,
   `github.com/billsix/geometricalgebra`):
   - `tasks/reference/book-and-docs-pipeline.md` § "ePiX figures: Python sources,
     rendered at build (2026-10-07)" — the pipeline this task copies.
   - `tasks/archive/2026/10/07/epix-plot-integration.md` — the **decision record**
     for adopting ePiX: the pinned commit, the `USE_EPIX` gating, and the explicit
     **coexist-not-replace** decision (matplotlib stayed for interactive
     notebooks; ePiX is the book's LaTeX-native figure source).
   - `tasks/archive/2026/10/07/book-epix-figures.md` (+ 3 step docs) — the
     per-section figure-porting work, a model for Phase 3 here.
4. ePiX source: `/foo/opt/epix-mirror` (mirror of Andrew D. Hwang's ePiX,
   `github.com/billsix/epix-mirror`, VERSION **1.2.22**, GPLv2+). It is a C++20
   library (`libepix.a`) + bash driver scripts (`epix`/`elaps`/`laps`/`flix`) +
   an additive **nanobind Python front-end** (`python/epix/`). It produces LaTeX
   `picture` macros (eepic/PSTricks/TikZ), vector eps/ps/pdf, and bitmap png via a
   `g++ → a.out → .eepic → latex → dvips → ghostscript/ImageMagick` chain. It is
   NOT a Python plotting library and NOT `pyx`-based.
   - **Pin note (re-checked 2026-10-11 after a fresh pull):** `epix-mirror` master
     HEAD is now `ebf3ca607ae6c1d4fa307e8b0359960d875d219c` — **the exact commit
     gacalc pins**. So gacalc's book is already built against current master, which
     validates copying its install scripts and renderer wholesale. Since the first
     survey (`024cc81`) the repo took a "dockerfile-to-standard-template" rework:
     the Fedora-package install is now split into canonical `entrypoint/
     01-install-base.sh` (Meson/ninja/gcc-c++/binutils/python3-devel + uv/ruff) and
     `entrypoint/02-install-render.sh` (ghostscript, ImageMagick, the texlive set),
     with a `MINIMAL_IMAGE` idiom matching mvp's. The four driver scripts
     (`scripts/{epix,elaps,laps,flix}.in`) are **unchanged**; `src/*.cc` changes
     were warning-level-3 cleanups, not API changes; `python/epix/{render,figure,
     __init__}.py` saw edits, but gacalc's renderer targets this very commit so its
     `fig.png` / `elaps --pdf` usage is current. One path detail at this commit:
     `libepix.a` installs to **`/usr/local/lib64/epix/`** (not `lib/epix`) — only
     matters if ever linking the C++ lib directly; the Python front-end path is
     unaffected.

**Why this is attractive for mvp specifically:** mvp's `mathutils.py` is already a
façade over gacalc, and the course's whole point is that transformations are
gacalc `InvertibleFunction`s composed along a Cayley graph. gacalc's book draws
its vector/projection/rotation figures with ePiX *using gacalc types*. mvp's
coordinate/transformation plots are the same genre of figure, so the toolchain is
a proven fit — and (see Q3) the figures could optionally drive mvp's *own* taught
transform code instead of the parallel `plotutils/mpltransformations.py`.

## mvp's current figure toolchains (the thing being changed)

All outputs land in `book/docs/_static/` (gitignored — `.gitignore` 24–26 ignore
`_static/*.png`, `*.svg`, `*.gif`) and are consumed by **30 `.rst` chapters via
134 `.. figure::`/`.. image::` directives**. Committed source art
(`_static/screenshots/`, `_static/ccbysa*/`, `_static/cc0/`, `Maththing.svg`) is
NOT generated — leave it alone.

| # | Source | Tool | Count | ePiX fit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `_static/*.tex` (Cayley edge labels) | `texExpToPng --size 300` → png | 35 | **No** — math-expression rasterization, not figures |
| 2 | `_static/*.dot` (Cayley graphs) | graphviz `dot -Tpng` | 29 | **No** — auto-layout graph engine; ePiX has no layout. *Also embeds the #1 PNGs as `<IMG SRC>` edge labels, so #1 cannot be removed while #2 exists.* |
| 3 | `_static/gnuplot/*.gp` (+10 `.dat`) | gnuplot → svg, inkscape → png | 21 `.gp`, **14 referenced** | **Yes → port** — 2D coordinate/space plots (`monitor`, `screenspace`, `ndcSpace`, `modelspace`, `viewport`, `disproportionate`, `plot1-4`) |
| 4 | `plotsforbook/generate_plots.py` (`generate_plots_for_book` console script) | matplotlib (agg) | ~23 families, **21 frames referenced** | **Yes → port** the 5 live families (`translation-forwards`, `translation2-forwards`, `incorrectrotate-forwards`, `rotate-sloppy-forwards`, `scale`). The ~18 other families are orphaned (Q5). |
| 5 | `.. inlinetex::`/`:itex:` in `.rst` | `_ext/inlinetex.py` → texExpToPng → `_static/inlinetex/<sha1>.png` | inline | **No** — body-text math; the book's standing rule is "never author `:math:`", use `inlinetex` |
| — | `notebooksrc/*.py` (3) | jupytext → ipynb, nbsphinx executes matplotlib | 3 | **No** — executed interactive notebooks |

Driver detail worth knowing before touching anything (all from
`tasks/reference/book-figures-and-images.md`): the matplotlib generator runs via a
**dummy make target** (`rotate0-0.svg: …/generate_plots.py`) and writes
`./<name>-<n>.svg` **relative to cwd**, so it only works because make runs it from
`_static/`; the generated SVGs are untracked and persist across incremental
builds, which is why a **clean build (`git clean -fdx` or fresh container) is the
only honest test**; `book/docs/Makefile` runs `cd _static && make` before Sphinx
and re-copies PNGs after; `conf.py` converts SVG→PDF for the LaTeX build via an
inkscape `imgconverter` entry (`latex_engine = "lualatex"`).

## The gacalc pattern this task replicates (verified in `/foo/opt/geometricalgebra`)

1. **Dockerfile:** `ARG USE_EPIX=0` + `ARG EPIX_COMMIT=<sha>` (gacalc's current
   pin is `ebf3ca607ae6c1d4fa307e8b0359960d875d219c`, master as of 2026-10-06), a
   gated `RUN` that calls two scripts (`Dockerfile:156-162`).
2. **The dnf package list.** gacalc's `entrypoint/06-install-epix.sh` was
   hand-curated against the *old* epix-mirror layout. At the current pin the
   authoritative lists are epix-mirror's own split scripts — take the package set
   from these, not from the older gacalc copy:
   - `01-install-base.sh` (build): `meson ninja-build gcc-c++ binutils
     python3-devel python3-setuptools python3-wheel uv` (plus `libasan
     clang-tools-extra ruff`, which mvp does **not** need — it has its own ruff and
     no ePiX C++ gate).
   - `02-install-render.sh` (render): `ghostscript ImageMagick` + texlive
     `collection-basic/-latexrecommended/-pictures/-fontsrecommended`, `eepic`,
     `epstopdf`, `dvips`, `collection-pstricks`, `pgf`.
   **mvp already installs the entire `02-install-render` stack** under `BUILD_DOCS`
   (texlive, ghostscript, ImageMagick, inkscape). The genuinely new packages for
   mvp are the **`01-install-base` build toolchain** (meson/ninja/gcc-c++/binutils/
   python3-devel; mvp likely already has setuptools/wheel/uv) — verify each
   `texlive-*` name against mvp's Dockerfile and only add what's missing
   (`texlive-eepic` is the most likely gap).
3. **`entrypoint/install-epix.sh`** — shallow `git fetch --depth 1 origin
   $EPIX_COMMIT` of `epix-mirror` into `/epix`; `meson setup build
   --prefix=/usr/local && meson install`; `uv pip install nanobind`; run
   epix-mirror's own `entrypoint/build_py.sh` (builds the nanobind extension
   against the installed `libepix.a`); **move `/epix` → `/opt/epix-src`** (a dir
   literally named `epix` in `/` shadows the Python package during a Dockerfile
   `RUN`, because cwd `/` is `sys.path[0]` — a real bug gacalc hit); `uv pip
   install -e /opt/epix-src/python` into the venv. Verify `epix --version` and
   `python -c 'import epix; epix.Point(x=1,y=2)'` from cwd `/`.
4. **Figures** authored as jupytext percent `.py` under `book/figures/epix/`,
   `import epix`, scene built inside `with epix.figure(...) as fig:`, `fig` left
   at module level; **every argument keyword-only** (gacalc gates this with
   `tools/check_epix_keywords.py`); `fig` typed through the
   `from epix.figure import _Pending as PendingFigure` alias.
5. **Renderer** `tools/render_epix_figures.py` runs each non-`_`-prefixed figure
   in a **fresh interpreter** (`runpy.run_path` in a `_CHILD` subprocess —
   `libepix` keeps global drawing state with no reset), writes `<name>.pdf` via
   `elaps --pdf` over the eepic text and `<name>.png` via the figure object's
   lazily-rasterized `.png` flattened onto a solid background with ImageMagick
   (so dark-mode HTML pages don't show a transparent sheet; default `#f2f2f2`,
   per-figure override via module-level `BACKGROUND`). Guard: exit 2 with a
   message if `elaps` is absent (lean/`USE_EPIX=0` image).
6. **Consumption:** renderer called from the docs build script *before*
   `sphinx-build`; outputs to `book/docs/_static/epix/`; chapters reference
   `.. figure:: _static/epix/<name>.*` (wildcard → PDF for the `latex` builder,
   PNG for `html`). No SVG — PDF for LaTeX, PNG for HTML.

## Proposed plan (scope settled: gnuplot + matplotlib → ePiX, driving taught code)

Each phase is a commit boundary. Phases 1–2 are mechanical infrastructure; Phase 3
is the real work and should be done family-by-family with a pilot first.

**Phase 0 — Scope (settled 2026-10-11).** Q1–Q5 all answered (see "Decisions
settled" and "Q5 settled"). No open questions remain; the plan is ready to
execute on go-ahead.

**Phase 1 — Container (`USE_EPIX` install).** Add `ARG USE_EPIX`/`ARG
EPIX_COMMIT` + the gated `RUN` to mvp's `Dockerfile`; add the install scripts
(copy gacalc's `install-epix.sh` *fetch + meson-install + build_py.sh +
`/epix`→`/opt/epix-src` move* verbatim — it already targets this exact pin — but
take the dnf package set from epix-mirror's current `01-install-base.sh` /
`02-install-render.sh`, trimmed to only what mvp's `BUILD_DOCS` block doesn't
already install, per "the dnf package list" above); add
`--build-arg USE_EPIX=$(USE_EPIX)` to the Makefile
`image` target with a matching default (mvp convention: Makefile default `1`,
Dockerfile default `0` — see `CLAUDE.md` § "Keeping the Dockerfile, Makefile … in
sync"). Tie `USE_EPIX ?= $(if $(filter 1,$(MINIMAL_IMAGE)),0,1)` so a lean image
drops it, matching gacalc. **Verify in a throwaway Fedora 44 container** (the
`CLAUDE.md` pattern) that `import epix` and `elaps --version` both work before
touching any figure. Gate: `make image` green.

**Phase 2 — Renderer + build wiring.** Port `tools/render_epix_figures.py`
(fresh-interpreter rendering, `elaps --pdf` + `fig.png` flatten) and the
`check_epix_keywords.py` gate. Decide output dir (recommend `_static/epix/` to
keep ePiX outputs separate from the legacy flat `_static/` so the two can coexist
during migration). Wire the renderer into `entrypoint/entrypoint.sh` *before* `cd
book/docs; make html` — alongside the existing `generate_plots_for_book` call, not
replacing it yet. Gate: one hand-written pilot figure renders to PDF+PNG.

**Phase 3 — Port the ~35 live figures, family by family (the work).** Create
`book/figures/epix/` with shared `_*_scene.py` helpers (mirror gacalc's
`_scene2d.py`). Figures **drive mvp's own taught transforms** (Q3): import from
`modelviewprojection.mathutils` (the gacalc façade) and compose
`InvertibleFunction`s, so each picture is produced by the exact functions its
chapter teaches. **Pilot first:** convert one simple gnuplot figure (e.g.
`modelspace`) end-to-end, build the book, eyeball PDF+PNG parity. Then:
  - **3a — gnuplot, the 14 referenced plots.** `monitor`, `monitor2`,
    `screenspace`, `screenspace2`, `ndcSpace`, `ndcSpace1`, `modelspace`,
    `viewport`, `disproportionate1`, `disproportionate2`, `plot1-4`. Static single
    figures — the easy half. (The other 7 `.gp` targets are unreferenced; treat
    like the matplotlib orphans under Q5.)
  - **3b — matplotlib, the 21 referenced frames across 5 families.**
    `translation-forwards-{0,2,3}`, `translation2-forwards-{0,2,3}`,
    `incorrectrotate-forwards-{1..6}`, `rotate-sloppy-forwards-{3..8}`,
    `scale-{0,2,4}` — numbered stills showing successive steps of a composed
    transform chain (NOT animations; see Decisions). A parametrized ePiX generator
    per family emits exactly the referenced frame numbers. **Only these 5 families
    are ported;** the ~18 orphaned families are not (Q5). Convert one family as a
    second pilot before the rest.

**Phase 4 — Rewire references + retire replaced plumbing.** Update the `.rst`
`.. figure::` directives for converted figures to `_static/epix/<name>.*`. Once
the 14 gnuplot + 21 matplotlib figures are ported **and Q5 confirms the orphans
are dead**, remove the whole math-plot plumbing: the gnuplot subtree
(`_static/gnuplot/`), `generate_plots.py` + `plotutils/` (including
`mpltransformations.py`, now superseded by driving `mathutils`) + the
`generate_plots_for_book` console-script entry in `pyproject.toml`, and the
`_static/Makefile` gnuplot/matplotlib rules + the `rotate0-0.svg` dummy target.
**Leave graphviz, the 35 `.tex` labels, `inlinetex`, and the notebook pipeline
fully intact** (out of scope). Note the #1↔#2 coupling: the `.tex` label PNGs stay
because the `.dot` graphs embed them as `<IMG SRC>`. If Q5 comes back "some
orphans are wanted," port those too rather than deleting them.

**Phase 5 — Clean-build verification.** `git clean -fdx` (or fresh container),
then full in-container `make html` + `make latexpdf` + `make epub`; confirm the
clean-build warning count doesn't regress (the `--system` saga is why clean builds
matter — `book-figures-and-images.md` §1). Run the `USE_EPIX=0` / `MINIMAL_IMAGE`
permutation to confirm a lean image still builds (renderer guard fires cleanly).
Then update `CLAUDE.md` + `tasks/reference/book-figures-and-images.md` to describe
the new toolchain, and stage.

## Decisions settled (2026-10-11, William Emerison Six <billsix@gmail.com>)

- **Q1 — Scope = (a): math plots only.** ePiX replaces the live gnuplot and
  matplotlib figures; graphviz Cayley graphs, the `texExpToPng`/`.tex` labels,
  `inlinetex`, and the executed notebooks stay. ePiX's domain is
  mathematically-accurate figures, not graph auto-layout, math-expression
  rasterization, or notebooks — gacalc made the same coexist call. The #1↔#2
  coupling means the `.tex` labels stay regardless (the `.dot` graphs embed them).
- **Q2 — Keep per-frame static; no animation.** There are **no generated animated
  GIFs** in the book (verified: the only `.gif` is an external CC-BY-SA Wikipedia
  `Animhorse.gif`, committed art). The matplotlib "step-sequence" families are
  embedded as individual static stills, never stitched into motion. So the ePiX
  figures stay per-frame static; the ePiX `flix` animation path is dropped from
  the plan entirely.
- **Q3 — Drive mvp's own taught code.** Figures import `modelviewprojection.
  mathutils` and compose gacalc `InvertibleFunction`s — the picture is generated by
  the functions the chapter teaches (the thesis of the course). This retires
  `plotutils/mpltransformations.py`.
- **Q4 — Pin `EPIX_COMMIT = ebf3ca607ae6c1d4fa307e8b0359960d875d219c`.** Clarified:
  mvp the *project* isn't "pinned" to anything — mvp is the consumer. It pins its
  dependencies in its own Dockerfile: it already pins **gacalc** (`gacalc==X` +
  `ARG GACALC_VERSION`), and this task adds **`ARG EPIX_COMMIT`** pinning which
  `epix-mirror` *commit* mvp builds against. That value is `ebf3ca6` — today the
  same commit gacalc pins and `epix-mirror` master, so all three stay in lockstep;
  bump together later.
- **Author figures in the Python front-end, not native `.xp`.** Matches gacalc;
  figures stay runnable as jupytext notebooks, and mvp is a Python-first teaching
  repo. (gacalc decision record, 2026-10-07.)
- **Reuse gacalc's install scripts; take the dnf package set from epix-mirror's
  current split scripts.** Don't reinvent the `/epix`→`/opt/epix-src` shadow fix or
  the nanobind build; copy and trim.
- **Separate output dir `_static/epix/`.** Lets ePiX and legacy outputs coexist
  during a family-by-family migration instead of a big-bang cutover.
